message.switch_success: App & Component Library switched to English

basic.langUsageDesc: Texts live in src/i18n/locales (zh-CN.json / en-US.json) and are read via $t or getI18nText. Switching language only needs useI18nStore().setLocale(); the whole page re-renders reactively and the choice is persisted automatically.
basic.langCardTransDesc: $t(key) resolves the text for the current locale. A missing key returns the key itself, so misconfigurations are easy to spot (it neither throws nor returns an empty string).
basic.langCardNamedDesc: Use a {msg} placeholder in the message and pass the same named argument at call time; each locale has its own copy of the placeholder text.
basic.langCardTextUtilDesc: getI18nText detects key-shaped text (contains a dot and is printable ASCII only) and translates it; plain display text such as Chinese titles is returned as-is, avoiding missing-key console noise. An explicit %key% wrapper forces translation.
basic.langCardTitle: 4. Set the navigation bar title dynamically
basic.langCardTitleDesc: setNavigationBarTitle(key) sets the native navbar title for the current locale and emits a setNavbarTitle event to keep the custom navbar in sync.
basic.langCardSwitchDesc: setLocale() syncs the global vue-i18n locale and persists it; the custom TabBar text is refreshed via setTabbarItem().
